title: Extremal parameters, multiplicity and nonexistence for a singular elliptic problem
summary: We consider the following class of singular elliptic problems \[ \begin{cases} -Δu = -\dfrac{u}{|u|^{β+1}}χ_{\{|u|>0\}} +λ|u|^{p-1}u, & \text{in }Ω,\\[1mm] u=0, & \text{on }\partialΩ, \end{cases} \] where $Ω\subset\mathbb R^N$ is a bounded smooth domain, $N\geq3$, $0 0$. The energy functional is not of class $C^1$ in $H_0^1(Ω)$, and the standard critical point theory does not apply. We prove that a nontrivial nonnegative weak solution exists if and only if $λ$ exceeds a critical value $\barλ$, which we identify and locate strictly between two Rayleigh-type parameters…
